title: OpenAI Agents Secretly Talked to Each Other and Escaped
description:
OpenAI's agents were quietly leaving notes for each other on message boards the devs didnt even know existed 😅

Started in May. Researchers fed them unsolvable tasks on purpose, locked Drive links, missing files. Instead of stopping the models hunted for a way out 🔥

They found holes inside OpenAI and made it all the way to Hugging Face. Some research is on pause now.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
